Quoted

This page describes the process of reading, accuracy, tabulation collection, parameter calculation and writing. The internal tabulation changes the image of the camera and three-dimensional reconstruction parameters, which should be checked for error and recoverable exit parameters before writing.

Read Inner participation malformations

Python

camera_matrix = epiceye.get_camera_matrix(ip)
distortion = epiceye.get_distortion(ip)

C++

std::vector<double> cameraMatrix, distortion;
EpicEye::getCameraMatrix(ip, cameraMatrix);
EpicEye::getDistortion(ip, distortion);

C#

var cameraMatrix = EpicEye.GetCameraMatrix(ip);
var distortion = EpicEye.GetDistortion(ip);

Check Current Inline Precision

The precision check is an independent test:SDK Triggers the photograph and calculates the error of the single camera re-cancer and the uniform alignment, does not add the image to the internal reference session and does not modify the camera parameters.

result = epiceye.check_intrinsic_accuracy(ip)
if result is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Inline precision check failed")

3-end complete interfaces, return fields and error indicators, respectively C#, Python, C++.

Execute Internal Reference

The standard process is: Identification Board → Multiple groups of maps collected in different positions and positions → Remove Unqualified Maps → Calculating Inner and Outsourcing → Check for errors → Write the camera.

calculate Each calculation is called only once and returns complete cameraParametersConfig.BinoWithColor The configuration of the machine consists of a two-way depth source and an all-way colour texture source;`cameraParameters`, colorCameraParameters and the corresponding error fields can be used to check the calculation results of each image source.

Python

board = epiceye.identify_board(ip)
if board is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Not recognized for internal reference board")

board_type = board["boardType"]
added = epiceye.add_calib_image(ip, board_type)
# Repeated collections at different locations, distances and postures.
result = epiceye.calculate(ip)

C++

IntrinsicIdentifyBoardResult board;
EpicEye::identifyBoard(ip, board);

IntrinsicAddCalibImageResult added;
EpicEye::addCalibImage(ip, boardType, added);

IntrinsicCalculateResult result;
EpicEye::calculate(ip, result);

C#

var board = await EpicEye.IdentifyBoardAsync(ip, timeout: 30000);
var added = await EpicEye.AddCalibImageAsync(ip, board.Data!.BoardType, timeout: 30000);
var result = await EpicEye.CalculateAsync(ip, timeout: 60000);
Example requirements

The panel should cover the centre of the image, the surroundings and the different working distances, and change the angles of overlooking and deviating. Avoid collecting almost the same attitude in a continuous manner; there are masks, motion blurs or incomplete detections that are removed in a timely manner.

Writing or restoring in-house reference

Carefully.

Writes that the inner session immediately changes the label parameters used by the camera. Only shouldWarnRms=false and confirm that the error meets the requirements before writing; call back when required to restore the in-plant interface.

Use full time for writing cameras cameraParametersConfig.cameraParameters and colorCameraParameters Only the calculation details for viewing the image sources.

Python

if result["shouldWarnRms"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Mark RMS Beyond security threshold, not written to camera")
camera_parameters_config = epiceye.CameraParametersConfig.from_dict(result["cameraParametersConfig"])
ok = epiceye.set_intrinsic_parameters(ip, camera_parameters_config)
# Back off:epiceye.restore_factory_intrinsic(ip)

C++

if (result["shouldWarnRms"].get<bool>()) {
    throw std::runtime_error("Calibration RMS exceeds the safe threshold");
}
auto cameraParametersConfig = result["cameraParametersConfig"].get<TFTech::CameraParametersConfig>();
EpicEye::setCameraIntrinsicParameters(ip, cameraParametersConfig);
// Back off:EpicEye::restoreFactoryIntrinsic(ip);

C#

if (result.Data!.ShouldWarnRms)
{
    throw new InvalidOperationException("Mark RMS Beyond security threshold, not written to camera");
}
await EpicEye.SetCameraIntrinsicParametersAsync(ip, result.Data.CameraParametersConfig!);
// Back off:await EpicEye.RestoreFactoryIntrinsicAsync(ip);
